Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail
